description: disc-5 parity test (#4401, continuation of the [W] winding-lattice probe): does the braid word's winding PARITY carry the S-channel sign flip, via Bring's golden order ℤ[φ]? Derived structural contrast: the cusp-torus order ℤ[√3] has fundamental unit 2+√3 of norm +1, so x_n²−3y_n² = +1 for ALL n — no parity flip is available there; Bring's ℤ[φ] has fundamental unit φ of norm −1, so L_n²−5F_n² = 4(−1)ⁿ — the parity flip exists on Bring and is structurally impossible on the cusp torus. The bar-split of x = φⁿ shows the author's odd/even channel structure exactly: which of (L_n, F_n√5) is the cosh and which the sinh SWAPS with the parity of n, both obeying the proved barEven²−barOdd²=4. Sign check, parameter-free: canonical braid words are powers of w = σ₁σ₂⁻¹ (4₁ = w², n=2 even; Borromean L6a4 = w³, n=3 odd), and the rule sign S = (−1)ⁿ predicts muon + / proton − — matching both observed anchors, 2/2, with no tuning. HONEST SCOPE: the parity→S-sign LINK is derived only on the disc-12 cusp torus ([W]); on Bring it is transported by ANALOGY (the Bring-side complex-volume computation is not done) — a conjectural mechanism supported by 2 bits, not a derivation. HONEST NEGATIVE: |N(φⁿ)| = 1 ∀n predicts equal magnitudes vs the observed ratio 4.075; the best natural φ-candidate misses by ≫0.1%. Magnitudes left open and not pursued — cusp shapes are dense in Teichmüller space (Dang–Purcell), making magnitude-chasing by knot/cusp selection a fit trap. No fit, no c_k, no instance.

disc5_parity_readout.golden_order: ℤ[φ], φ=(1+√5)/2, fundamental unit norm −1 ⇒ L_n²−5F_n² = 4(−1)ⁿ
disc5_parity_readout.cusp_order: ℤ[√3], fundamental unit 2+√3 norm +1 ⇒ x_n²−3y_n² = +1 ∀n (no parity flip)
disc5_parity_readout.channel_swap: bar-split of φⁿ: n even → (barEven,barOdd)=(L_n,F_n√5); n odd → (F_n√5,L_n) — cosh/sinh identity swaps with parity
disc5_parity_readout.braid_powers: 4₁ = w² (n=2, even); Borromean L6a4 = w³ (n=3, odd); w = σ₁σ₂⁻¹
disc5_parity_readout.verdict: parity carries the SIGN (2/2, no tuning) and disc-5 is structurally the only one of the two orders that can; parity→S-sign link transported to Bring by ANALOGY (conjectural, 2 bits, not a derivation); magnitudes OPEN and not pursued (dense-cusp-shape fit trap)
